subject: Partner-led discovery: Acme / CloudBridge — next steps & tech deep dive
messages:
From: Anand Patel <anand@cloudbridge.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@gsico.com>
Date: 2026-03-01T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Partner-led discovery recap & next steps

Hi Marissa / Sarah —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from CloudBridge side after our discovery call:

- Goal: streamline Acme's marketplace procurement + integrate Redwood Inference as a pre-qualified inference runtime across CloudBridge-managed customers.
- Key technical constraints Sarah flagged: VPC peering limits, audit log retention, and support for private model deployment behind a marketplace listing.
- Success criteria: predictable latency under 200ms p95 for typical queries, signed MSA + Marketplace listing within the quarter.

Next steps we discussed:
1) Schedule a 60-minute technical deep dive / demo with Redwood SEs and CloudBridge solutions engineering to walk through integration points and sequence (marketplace listing, onboarding, SSO/KMS).
2) Share a short POC requirements checklist (we attached a suggested MOP).
3) Align on timelines and any procurement prerequisites.

Proposed time windows (PDT):
- Tue 2026-03-03 09:00-11:00
- Wed 2026-03-04 10:00-12:00
- Thu 2026-03-04 14:00-16:00

Please confirm which slot works or propose alternatives. I attached our MOP (summary doc) for reference.

Thanks,
Anand Patel
Head of Partnerships, CloudBridge
Attachment: cloudbridge-mop-overview.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Anand Patel <anand@cloudbridge.io>, Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-01T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Partner-led discovery recap & next steps

Thanks Anand — great summary and appreciate the MOP.

We’re excited to move forward. Quick notes from Redwood:
- Rishi will own commercial cadence and contracting for Acme (cc'd).
- Dylan (cc'd) will lead the technical deep dive / demo and cover private deployment/marketplace integration patterns.
- Vanessa (cc'd) will help coordinate Marketplace/partner listing requirements on our side.

Our availability (PDT):
- Tue 2026-03-03 09:00-10:30
- Wed 2026-03-04 10:00-11:30
- Thu 2026-03-04 14:00-15:30

If any of those align with Anand's windows, Dylan can book a Google Calendar invite. Alternatively, here's a quick scheduling link: https://calendly.com/redwood-inference/60min-demo?month=2026-03

Dylan — can you include a short agenda and any pre-reqs (sample architecture diagram, list of required IAM roles, and whether a test account is needed)?

Attaching our partner brief for context.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-partner-brief.pdf

Hi all —

Thanks for the recap. We’re keen to see the deep dive. The Tue 3/3 09:00-10:30 PDT slot works best for our team.

A couple quick asks so we can prep internally:
- Can you share a short agenda (60 mins) and any pre-reqs (access, test data, network IP ranges)?
- Will the session include a short live demo + Q&A and a separate design review?

We can invite our infra lead if you want someone on the call for the VPC/KMS details.

Thanks,
Sarah Lee
Director, Infrastructure — Acme Corporation
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acme.com>, Anand Patel <anand@cloudbridge.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-02T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Partner-led discovery recap & next steps — Confirming Tue 3/3 09:00 PDT

Perfect — thanks Sarah and Anand. I’ve locked Tue 2026-03-03 09:00-10:00 PDT on everyone’s calendars and sent a Google Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234efgh

Agenda (60 minutes):
- 09:00-09:10 — Quick intros and success criteria (Marissa / Anand / Sarah)
- 09:10-09:30 — Redwood technical demo: hosted vs private deployment patterns + marketplace onboarding checklist (Dylan)
- 09:30-09:50 — Integration touchpoints: network, SSO/KMS, logging & audit (Anand + Sarah)
- 09:50-10:00 — Next steps & POC alignment (Rishi / Marissa)

Pre-reqs / Ask list:
- A test account with a role that can create service accounts or we can do a read-only run if preferred.
- IP ranges for any firewall rules (if private VPC peering is required).
- Relevant compliance requirements (retention, SOC2 controls) by EOD Mon so we can highlight them.

Attachments: acme-arch-sketch.png (high-level sketch we’ll use in the call).

If anything changes, let me know — otherwise see you Tue.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: acme-arch-sketch.png
